_comment: Mixin handler methods known to fatally crash on the target MC and unrepairable by renaming.
If "methods" is omitted or empty, EVERY method on the class is stripped (whole-mixin fallback,
use sparingly). The classes remain in the jar so nothing else that references them breaks;
only the annotated handler bodies go, so Mixin skips them without ever seeing a broken selector.
Approach borrowed from Retromod (mixin-blocklist.json). Extend this file as real failures come
in from the community — grow it the same way rules.json grows.

entries.reason: @ModifyVariable target addMessage → addPlayerMessage signature shift on 26.2; Mixin scans 0 targets despite refmap resolving — curated strip until root-caused
